## Goal

Validate whether student organization officers and student founders have a real, repeated pain around tracking email follow-ups before implementing Gmail sync or AI drafting.

## Current Evidence

- [x] 10 potential users listed
- [x] 5 outreach messages sent
- [ ] 3 real interviews completed
- [ ] 5 real pain records captured
- [x] Synthetic anonymous planning examples prepared

## Hypothesis

Student organization officers and student founders sometimes lose track of email threads that need follow-up, especially around events, partnerships, speakers, sponsors, member coordination, and early user conversations.

## MVP Decision

Start with manual email/thread input because it avoids OAuth complexity and lets the product prove value before requesting mailbox access.

## Out Of Scope For First MVP

- Gmail OAuth
- Gmail sync
- Automatic email sending
- Full CRM
- Multi-user team permissions
- AI draft generation

## Definition Of Done

- [ ] Evidence table is updated with real users and real quotes
- [ ] MVP scope is selected and documented
- [ ] README clearly separates synthetic examples from real evidence
- [ ] Demo workflow exists using manual imported examples
- [ ] Follow-up issue created for Gmail read-only sync decision
